info.name: E-Commerce API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete test collection for E-Commerce API

Implemented Endpoints:
- Authentication: Register, Login, Admin creation ✓
- Users: Profile, Orders, Payments, Update ✓
- Categories: Full CRUD (DFS + Redis caching) ✓
- Products: Full CRUD + Recommendations (DFS) ✓
- Orders: Create orders, view own orders, cancel orders ✓
- Payments: Initiate payment, webhooks & callbacks (Stripe & bKash) ✓

Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api/v1

Test Coverage:
- ✓ Role-based Authorization (RolesGuard) - Customer cannot access admin endpoints
- ✓ Session-based Authorization - Users cannot access other users' data
- ✓ Authentication & Validation tests
- ✓ Category CRUD with hierarchical structure
- ✓ Product CRUD with OOP Product class
- ✓ Product Recommendations using DFS (Req 2.2.5)
- ✓ Order Management with OOP Order/OrderItem classes
- ✓ Payment System with Strategy Pattern (Stripe & bKash)

Requirements Alignment:
- ✓ User Management (2.1.1)
- ✓ Category Management with DFS + Caching (2.2.5)
- ✓ Product Management with OOP Product class (2.1.2, 2.2.1)
- ✓ Product Recommendations using DFS (2.2.5)
- ✓ Order Management with OOP Order/OrderItem classes (2.1.3, 2.2.1, 2.2.3)
- ✓ Payment System with Strategy Pattern (2.1.4, 2.2.4)
- ✓ Role-based Access Control (RolesGuard)
- ✓ Session-based Access Control

request.description:
Confirm a Stripe Payment Intent with a test payment method token (pm_card_visa). This directly calls Stripe's API to confirm the payment.

⚠️ Prerequisites:
- Set 'stripe_secret_key' collection variable with your Stripe secret key (sk_test_...)
- Run 'Initiate Payment - Stripe' first to get payment_intent_id

✅ After confirmation:
- Payment status will be 'succeeded' in Stripe
- Stripe will automatically send webhook to your backend
- Your backend will update payment status and mark order as PAID
- Product stock will be reduced automatically

💡 Make sure Stripe CLI is running to forward webhooks to your local backend.

📚 Test Payment Method Tokens:
- pm_card_visa - Visa (succeeds)
- pm_card_mastercard - Mastercard (succeeds)
- pm_card_chargeDeclined - Card declined
- See https://stripe.com/docs/testing#cards for more options
